ValidationRule.description: If Online Scheduling Enabled value is "Yes," Web Schedule Start Date,Start Time,End Date,End Time fields must be populated.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: ISPICKVAL(Online_Scheduling_Enabled__c, "Yes") && Is_Template__c != True && ( ISBLANK(Web_Schedule_EndDate__c) || ISBLANK(Web_Schedule_End_Time__c) || ISBLANK(Web_Schedule_StartDate__c) || ISBLANK(Web_Schedule_Start_Time__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: This blood drive is enabled for online scheduling. Please enter a Web Schedule Start Date,Start Time,End Date,End Time
